item.title: Wyoming · The purpose of this meeting is to finalize the Committee's interim work. The Committee will consider bill drafts and receive information on: 1) residential property tax; 2) governmental property; 3) industrial property tax; 4) motor vehicle property tax relief; 5) vehicle sales tax collection; 6) sales and use tax exemption reporting requirements; 7) penny rounding; 8) linear infrastructure taxation; 9) modified netback; 10) severance tax: and 11) electricity taxation.
